title: Muldoon: Americans wanted Kaikoura shut down

tellings.quote: Anyway, he chuckled. And I remember he just let slip something like, "Yeah, the Americans wanted that one shut down pretty quickly."

plain: The Americans wanted the Kaikoura case, a UFO episode in New Zealand in the late 1970s, "shut down pretty quickly", according to a man named Robert Muldoon. Ross Coulthart tells Michels that when he raised it with Muldoon, Muldoon chuckled and "just let slip" that line. If true, it would mean Washington leaned on New Zealand to bury the case.
